annotations.title: What a US ETF added, dropped and reweighted

description: The changes in one US ETF's holdings from one issuer file to the next: the lines that entered and exited with their weights, largest first, and the lines whose weight moved by 0.05 points or more, before and after. It covers every step since a date, or the latest step when no date is given. Each step names the file it is compared with and gives its turnover measures. Lines held two files earlier are marked as reverted; a step across a change of the keys or of the reading of the file is marked restated and lists no trades.

limit.description: The most lines listed in each of entered, exited and moved for one step, largest first. The counts are always whole.

since.description: Only the steps to a file dated on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

ticker.description: A US ETF ticker, for example VOO. Case does not matter.
